notes.title: 🏠 Chill Pulse Update – Mysterious Bellemare Manor Arrives! 🌌🔦
notes.content:
Dear Players,

A brand-new 80s-inspired indoor scene, “Bellemare Manor,” is now available! 🏚️ Step into this dimly lit, eerie space where an old TV flickers with strange images, and whispers echo through the telephone… Can you uncover the hidden secrets of this mysterious mansion? 🕵️‍♂️✨

🔮 Update Highlights:
🏚️ New Scene: Bellemare Manor – A nostalgic yet unsettling 80s-style interior, filled with vintage furniture, old cassette tapes, and an eerie atmosphere.
🥤 New Drinks – Enjoy classic, retro-inspired beverages while immersing yourself in the mystery!
👕 New Costumes – 80s fashion is back! Rock neon T-shirts, varsity jackets, and more!
🎧 New Music – Synthwave beats and vintage cassette sounds will transport you back in time.
🕵️ New Suspenseful Adventure Story – The furniture in this manor seems to shift when you're not looking… Is it just your imagination, or is there something more going on?

📢 Important Notice:
Due to copyright issues, we regret to announce the removal of the Nezha outfit. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. We are working on new customization options for future updates! 💖

🏚️ Enter the game now and unravel the mysteries of Bellemare Manor!

— Chill Pulse Development Team 🚀

notes.title: Chill Pulse Game Update Announcement - Autumn Special Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Players,



Thank you for your ongoing support and love for "Chill Pulse"! We are excited to announce that the new Autumn update is now officially live! This update includes a series of new features and content aimed at enhancing your gaming experience and bringing more fun and convenience. Here are the highlights of this update:


[list]
[*][b]New Headwear[/b]: Add flair to your characters with our range of stylish new headwear, making your characters more personalized.
[*][b]LiveChat Feature[/b]: We've added a new LiveChat feature, allowing you to interact in real-time with other players, share gaming insights, or simply chat and relax.
[*][b]Collectible ToDoList[/b]: Knowing that repeatedly typing the same tasks is time-consuming and cumbersome, we have introduced a Collectible ToDoList feature. This allows players to create and save their own fixed ToDoLists, which can be called up with a single click, enhancing efficiency.
[*][b]Game Easter Egg - Jill's Accessories[/b]: As a tribute to the classic game "VA-11 Hall-A," we have included Jill's accessories as an Easter egg within the game. Come and explore to see if you can find them!
[*][b]Fore the Cat and Classic Drinks[/b]: Welcome Fore the Cat and several iconic drinks from "VA-11 Hall-A." These special additions will bring more style and fun to your gaming space.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922626/925fc5d92aba630f601782a5fc11f31582c202db.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922626/f1b4c4a57f9037a2e2899a4298c56f4a7d294d7c.png[/img]

We are committed to continuously improving "Chill Pulse," and we hope these new features will bring more convenience and enjoyment to your studying and work. Update the game now to start your Autumn journey and enjoy a unique Chill Pulse experience!

Happy gaming!

"Chill Pulse" Development Team

notes.title: Chill Pulse Launches New Space Theme Scene!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce the latest major update for Chill Pulse, now live! This update brings a brand-new space theme scene, offering a unique relaxation experience during your interstellar travels. We've carefully crafted cosmic-themed music suited for space roaming, complemented with beverages designed for interstellar travel to ensure a comfortable journey.

New stories: Inside your spacecraft, not only will you find "Raindrop," an AI robot ready to chat and keep you company during breaks, but there are also mysterious signals from distant galaxies waiting to be explored. notes.title: Diaries, Letters and more!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce the first major update to our game! This update includes a series of new features and improvements designed to enhance your gaming experience and address some known issues. We are grateful for your support and feedback, and here are the details of this update:

- Writing System Optimization - We've launched an even smoother and more intuitive writing system.

- Sticky Note Modification Feature - You can now modify the content on sticky notes anytime, making it more flexible and convenient.

- Diary System - Introducing a diary feature where players can record the little details and cherished memories within the game.

- Letter Features - We've added the ability to exchange letters with other characters, enhancing the game's interactivity and emotional depth.

- Borderless Window Mode - By popular demand, we've added a borderless window mode.

- Ultrawide Monitor Viewing Optimization - We have optimized the visual experience for ultrawide monitors.

- Pomodoro Timer Adjustability - The Pomodoro timer can now be more easily adjusted, helping players better manage gaming and rest times.

- More Robust Saving System - We've upgraded our saving system to be more stable, ensuring your game progress is securely saved.


We hope these updates will bring you a better gaming experience. Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. We will keep working hard to improve and update the game. Update now to experience these new features and join us on an even more exciting adventure!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Game Release Announcement: Embracing Exciting Updates Ahead
notes.content:
Dear Players,

With immense excitement, we are thrilled to announce that our game has officially been released! We want to express our gratitude to each and every one of you for your support and enthusiasm, as it is your passion that has infused this game with boundless vitality and possibilities.

When we first conceived this game, our intention was simply to create a small, relaxing software. However, upon its release, we were greeted with such warm reception and anticipation. Your enthusiasm inspires us and fills us with pride and a sense of great responsibility. Therefore, we are committed to living up to your expectations by going all out to add as much content and features to the game as possible.

We understand that the current content of the game may seem somewhat limited. However, rest assured, we will continuously strive to present a more diverse and vibrant gaming world. While we hope for the updates to be rolled out quickly, we also don't want to keep you waiting for too long. Hence, we promise to work tirelessly, day and night, to ensure the quality and timeliness of the updates.

In the forthcoming updates, we will actively incorporate new music, accessories, scenes, and more, to present a more complete and exciting gaming experience. We recognize that this is just the beginning, and there is much more excitement waiting for us to discover and explore.

Lastly, we want to thank each and every player for your support and attention to our game. It is because of your support that we can continue to progress and innovate. In the days ahead, let us work together to witness the growth and evolution of this game!

Thank you all!

notes.title: Urgent Request for Understanding: Delay in "Chill Pulse" Release
notes.content:
Dear "Chill Pulse" Community,

We are on the verge of the official launch of "Chill Pulse," however, we have encountered an urgent issue that may affect the scheduled release timing. During the final review process by Valve, some language issues were flagged, which appear to pertain to a version of the game that is not our final submission.

We were informed of language discrepancies in the game during Valve’s final review. Upon investigation, we believe that Valve may have reviewed an incorrect version, not the final one we submitted. We are urgently communicating with Valve to resolve this issue as quickly as possible.

To our friends in Asia, we realize it is quite late in your region. We deeply appreciate your patience and sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Please rest assured, we are making every effort to ensure you can experience "Chill Pulse" very soon. For your well-being, please consider getting some rest; we hope to bring you good news by tomorrow morning.

Please keep an eye on our official channels for continuous updates. Thank you once again for your understanding and support.

The "Chill Pulse" Development Team
